Khushi raasta hai.
Joy aatma ki dhoop hai.
Azaadi logon ke beech aam gyan ke bina nahi bach sakti.
Azaadi khoobsurat hai.
Khushi is baat ka saboot hai ki divya shakti hai.
Khushi waqt hona hai.
Khushi yeh ehsaas hai ki sab sahi chal raha hai.
Khushi khoobsurati ka shaant ehsaas hai.
Joy rooh ke andar ka sooraj hai.
Khushi ek aadat hai. Ise apnao.
Azaadi zulm ke khilaf sabse bada hathiyar hai.
Khushi neechi hai.
Khushi aantarik dhun hai.
Apne aap ko mansik gulami se azaad karo, koi aur hamare dimaag ko azaad nahi kar sakta.
Khushi pyaar ki bhor hai.
Khushi unchi hai.
Azaadi pasand ka kaam karne mein nahi, balki sahi kaam karne ke haq mein hai.
Azaadi ka matlab hai ki vyakti doosri ki manmaani ka gulam nahi hai.
Insaan azaad paida hota hai, par har jagah zanjeeron mein hai.
Aazadi ka koi fayda nahi agar usme galti karne ki aazadi na ho.
Joy lakho taro ke neeche tent lagane mein hai.
Joy hone ka jadoo hai.
Azadi apni marzi se jeene ka haq hai.
